name: flock-recoverable-provider-interruption-3157
instr:
airunner cannot safely recover provider runs interrupted by shutdown. Implement durable recovery that distinguishes resumable work, work known not to have started, and ambiguous work that must not be repeated.

Each Claude, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible runner must emit exactly one terminal `agent.EventTypeInterrupted` outcome containing only confirmed continuation and attempt identity. Ordinary terminal outcomes must not emit it. `agent.RecoveryDisposition` must contain exactly `agent.RecoveryResume` at iota, `agent.RecoveryRestart`, and `agent.RecoveryUnavailable`. Claude must expose and resume its last decoded session while preserving process-group cancellation and existing text, tool, and result mapping. Codex must expose and continue its last confirmed thread. OpenAI-compatible requests cancelled after dispatch must remain unavailable and never repeat automatically.

Store `runrecovery.AttemptID` evidence atomically and durably with `runrecovery.Open(path)`. `runrecovery.Decide` must combine the exact pending marker, evidence, and provider capability. Isolate records by chat and attempt across concurrent writes, reopening, cleanup, invalidation, and failures. `chat.New` and `chat.Service.RecoverInterrupted` must bind recovery to the marker that launched each attempt, including multiple queued attempts.

On startup, resume confirmed work, restart only work known not to have begun, and retain unsafe attempts for explicit disposition. On success, commit returned session stat
